builds.name: Angry Serra
builds.desc: Serra is angry, and she wants to dish out a lot of damage. This build turns her into a dedicated chipper unit, while still maintaining her healing capabilities with Recover. Her stats are what she needs, with medium attack, speed and res, with somewhat low hp and low def. Wrathful Staff is a no-brainer, as it allows her to be even angrier. Dual Savage blow allows her to deal 14 chip damage to units around her target, which is a noticeable amount. Her weapon is Pain+, which turns that 14 into a whopping 24 chip damage, while getting off some damage (Boosted by Wrathful Staff) and chipping on the main target for absolutely free. In order to do this you'll have to get Pain+ upgraded with the Dazzling Staff upgrade, requiring a further investment but allowing Serra to be the terror she can be. It is recommended to have a Hardy Bearing cleanup unit or a dancer to make her finish units off, as the chip damage will never kill her targets. This build can be also used as a finisher/DC negator, depending on the situation.
